title: created-issues.json
description: Machine-readable handoff emitted by the to-issues skill. Consumed by build-create-pr to auto-inject Closes #N into PR bodies.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a non-backwards-compatible way.

slug.description: The kebab-case feature slug — the spec folder name without the leading work-item key.

issue_number.description: GitHub issue number (real on a normal run; synthetic 1,2,3... in DRY_RUN=1 mode).

labels.description: Flat label list — entries follow the `dimension:value` convention (e.g. type:feat, tier:foundation, tech:python, module:to-issues).

blocked_by.description: Issue numbers (not story sequences) of upstream blockers — references real, already-created issues from earlier in the same batch.

milestone.description: GitHub milestone attached to the issue — read by issue-to-project extract_signals for Iteration and Date Target fields. Shape mirrors the GitHub Issues API: {title: string, due_on: string|null, ...}. May be absent when no milestone is set.
